title: Nasty Girls
creator: CrossFit
description: Three rounds of 50 squats, 7 muscle-ups and 10 hang power cleans at 135 lb. First posted in December 2005 and made famous by the video of Nicole Carroll, Eva T and Annie Sakamoto; a balanced mix of metabolic, gymnastic and weightlifting work. Substitute 3 pull-ups plus 3 dips per muscle-up if needed.
